title: From Uncertainty to Failure Attribution: Self-Diagnosing Models for Failure Attribution under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2608.07953v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distribution shift poses a significant challenge to the robustness of machine learning models, but the current solutions only aim to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) samples and predict uncertainty levels. We introduce a problem setting for failure attribution under distribution shift, which enables the models not only to detect OOD samples, but also to find out the reason for their failure. The solution we propose is called self-diagnosing models, which are capable of jointly learning predictive output, predictive uncertainty, and a failure attribution signal. In particular, we use the failure attribution vector, produced by a neural network, which provides a structured representation of predictive unreliability by distinguishing four different types of failures: covariance shift, semantic shift, noise corruption, and adversarial perturbation. translated_title: 从不确定性到故障归因：分布偏移下用于故障归因的自诊断模型
translated_abstract: 分布偏移对机器学习模型的鲁棒性构成了重大挑战，但目前的解决方案仅旨在检测分布外（OOD）样本并预测不确定性水平。我们引入了一个分布偏移下的故障归因问题设定，使模型不仅能够检测OOD样本，还能找出其失败的原因。我们提出的解决方案称为自诊断模型，它能够联合学习预测输出、预测不确定性和故障归因信号。特别地，我们使用由神经网络产生的故障归因向量，它通过区分四种不同类型的失败——协变量偏移、语义偏移、噪声破坏和对抗扰动——提供了预测不可靠性的结构化表示。换句话说，我们从标量不确定性迈向了故障识别。
tldr: 该论文提出自诊断模型，通过神经网络生成的故障归因向量，将分布偏移下的模型诊断从标量不确定性估计推进到能够区分协变量偏移、语义偏移、噪声破坏和对抗扰动四种具体失败类型的故障归因。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes self-diagnosing models that jointly learn predictions, uncertainty, and a failure attribution vector, advancing from scalar uncertainty estimation to identifying four specific failure types—covariance shift, semantic shift, noise corruption, and adversarial perturbation—under distribution shift.
